measurement: 120 fresh moving poses per population and revision. Each pose rebuilds geometry-dependent lighting, visibility, coefficients and the equilibrium from the current state. Median and p95 throughBothMs use the later of frame GPU completion and the matching compositor swap. Camera visibility overlaps construction. 4K framebuffer scaled by compositor. Peak counts instrumented engine and GPU payloads only. Runtime, driver, swap buffers and physical scanout unmeasured. Populations 1 and 2 mean individual slats. Population 0 uses two full blinds and four extra objects.
workCountsOrder: individual receiver using common lamp field
roundedVisibility: whole interval certified by its extremes
qualityNotes: Direct, indirect and total before/after across three distinct poses and one revisit per population. The revisits check exact pixel and work repeatability. A one-code difference from the previous playable solver measures change, not physical error.
orderNotes: Exact area mean of the playable bilinear reconstruction. The independent reference samples the selected area directly, with 2097152 paths and standard errors on per-path order contributions. The older 192 by 192 midpoint masked area average and 131072-path references are included separately. These estimators have different numerical and sampling errors.

scopedReceiverFunction.scene: Two slats, angle 0.3 and -0.4 rad, radii 0.044 and 0.033 m. North wall to finite floor to south wall. 16 upstream wall panels per axis. Separate composed-path probe.

sourceFieldAudit.nativeComparison: Independent refinements of the existing strip quadrature in 1200 qualifying actual source/receiver pairs. Not an independent physical reference. Error bound 0.00005 applies to the truncated kernel times source amplitude, before quadrature, rounding and equilibrium.

ui.interactions: Select 4K, change radius, enable second slat, change its angle, move furniture, change floor, cycle lamp power.

sheetOpeningCensus.scope: Lamp-dark source on a planar chart, fully above receiver horizon, with sheet blockers only on outgoing leg. These are midpoint opening counts in the native transverse slabs, a candidate decomposition. Establish endpoint ordering and certify visibility between events before using this for arbitrary scene edits.

twoDimensionalReceiverCensus.scope: Tick 30 on already qualified clear regional pairs. Counts potential replacement of receiver point evaluations with coefficient nodes. No change in production, no timing credit.

furtherFrustumExperiment.scope: Additional clearance proof on a detached candidate. Only 12 moving poses per population. Crowded median improved and p95 regressed. Inconclusive; excluded from production.
